description: A rehearsal of the first thirty days if the principal could not act, tested against what is recorded today. Three stages (Day 1: who is called; Week 1: what can be reached; Day 30: what can be paid), each step ready, blocked or not recorded, with what is missing. Counts and roles only, never a name or an account number. It tests the file, not the law, and it does not compare cash with costs yet. Nothing is stored. Read only.
